limitations: Synthetic fixtures and stdlib arithmetic only; no physical, biological, clinical, diagnostic or causal validity. No real VCF parsing, haploid/PAR, indel or multiallelic model.
Declared hashes and freeze timestamps cannot prove historical timing or source authenticity; coordinator-owned independent review stays unavailable in pack output.

Conservative case-insensitive whole-word English prefix families consume remaining word characters: caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, driv* including drive and drives, induc*. Additionally pathogen*, diagnos*, disease association separated by whitespace or hyphens, truth, physical validity separated by whitespace or hyphens. This lexical gate is incomplete and refuses negations too.

Unavailable text additionally refuses supported, replicated, suggestive and significan*. Any cited kind or result unavailable in evidence or source requires unavailable status even with mixed evidence. Known pack report/result sources are always computed. Positive claims check both kind and result for review, approv, comput, numer, physical, clinic and truth. Replicated is refused for a single synthetic fixture.
HWE is unavailable for monomorphic or insufficient controls and X; it does not by itself exclude a site. X uses a declared diploid heterozygosity proxy and does not establish sex identity.
